uncertainty: Six verified third-party YAML paths (js-yaml 5.5.0, yaml 2.9.1, yaml-ast-parser 0.0.43, @stoplight/yaml 4.3.0, yaml-eslint-parser 2.1.0, yaml-js 0.3.1), selected in descending npm last-month order (window 2026-10-18 to 2026-11-16) from two bounded npm searches (query 'yaml', first 100 of 41087 hits; query 'yaml parser', first 100 of 89726 hits, added in round 2) and named leads. js-yaml 5.5.0 ships its own YAML 1.2 event parser and constructor in one bundled dist/js-yaml.cjs.js. eemeli/yaml 2.9.1 has its own lexer, CST parser and composer. yaml-ast-parser 0.0.43 is a js-yaml 3.x fork that builds a YAML AST (83 of its 1,451 distinct source lines shared with js-yaml 5.5.0). @stoplight/yaml is a labelled wrapper: its own AST walker over @stoplight/yaml-ast-parser, a near-identical yaml-ast-parser fork (1,364 of 1,447 lines shared). yaml-eslint-parser is a labelled wrapper: its own ESTree AST conversion and value resolver over the yaml 2.9.1 Parser and Composer. yaml-js 0.3.1 is an archived line-for-line PyYAML port. Each adapter decodes local bytes as strict UTF-8, calls the documented text API with default options and maps the result to the Parsarium typed tree. JavaScript numbers lose YAML's int/float distinction, so a finite integral number is typed int; the controls contain no integral-valued floats or integer-like keys, so this cannot change the result. 1 leads are not counted (see leads.json): yamljs. npm downloads measure package adoption, largely transitive, not YAML parsing volume. Two schema-neutral valid controls do not establish tags, merge keys, multi-document streams, YAML 1.1-only scalars or malformed-input behavior.
